scripts.text:
[Starfish]
You alone is powerless, hehe!
Better get someone to help you out.
Make a party, and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
你一个人可不行哦，嘿嘿！
最好找个人来帮你。
组个队伍，稍后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Where is your leader, hehe.
I don't talk to some random people.
Bring your boss to me.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
你的首领呢，嘿嘿。
我不跟随便什么人说话。
把你的头头带来见我。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
I am guarding here, hehe!
It is just roughly blocked for now.
But someday this cave must be sealed forever, hehe!
scripts.translation:
[海星]
我在这里守卫呢，嘿嘿！
现在只是勉强堵住了而已。
总有一天，这个洞穴必须被永远封死，嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Ask what's going on.
scripts.translation: 询问发生了什么事

scripts.text: Ask to open the gate.
scripts.translation: 请求打开大门

scripts.text: Go to other location.
scripts.translation: 前往其他地点

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Lately, our Starfish lady is
suffering with some issues, ooh ooh.
Something bad happen in this
peaceful place, hehe!
scripts.translation:
[海星]
最近，我们的海星女士
遇到了一些麻烦，噢噢。
在这个平静的地方发生了
不好的事情，嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Weird looking limbs came out
from the hole there,
tried to kidnap our lady Starfish.
Ooh Ooh.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
奇怪的手臂从那个洞里伸出来，
试图绑架我们的海星女士。
噢噢。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
It seems those limbs belong to
that ugly octopus.
That monster should be taken care of,
but it's hard for ourselves only to make it happen, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
看来那些手臂属于
那只丑陋的章鱼。
那只魔物应该被处理掉，
但光靠我们自己很难做到，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
I want to find someone special,
and ask to punish this ugly octopus.
I hope this octopus won't ever
harass our lady, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
我想找个特别的人，
请求惩罚这只丑陋的章鱼。
希望这只章鱼以后
不要再骚扰我们的女士了，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Go catch that octopus and stick it to this pick.
If you bring back the pick, I will
open this gate for a while.
You should challenge if you are interested, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
去抓住那只章鱼，把它串在这根签子上。
如果你把签子带回来，我会
暂时打开这扇门。
如果你感兴趣的话，就来挑战吧，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Octopus is not around now, hehe.
Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
章鱼现在不在附近，嘿嘿。
请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Party name is... {0}.
Party leader is... {1}.
^0000ff{2}^000000, I cannot open now, hehe.
Now is not the time, please wait.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
队伍名称是... {0}。
队伍首领是... {1}。
^0000ff{2}^000000，我现在不能打开，嘿嘿。
现在不是时候，请等一下。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
I will open the gate for a while to ^0000ff{0}^000000.
Please catch that pervert octopus,
and come back with it sticked to the pick, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
我会暂时为^0000ff{0}^000000打开大门。
请抓住那只变态章鱼，
把它串在签子上带回来，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Prepare a pick first,
so you can thread that octopus
with that pick.
Then, I will let you in for a while, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
先准备一根签子，
这样你才能把那只章鱼
串在签子上。
然后，我会让你暂时进去，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
This is not a good location, check someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
这里不是个好地方，去别处看看吧。

scripts.text:
There is a strange entrance
blocked roughly with some boards.
scripts.translation:
有一个奇怪的入口，
被几块木板勉强堵住了。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Ah, now is not the time...
Would you come back later? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
啊，现在不是时候...
你能稍后再来吗？嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
There is a secret with that entrance.
So, please be careful with it, will ya? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
那个入口有个秘密。
所以，请小心一点，好吗？嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Shhh... Weird aura is
coming from that entrance.
Big trouble is waiting, if you go in now.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
嘘... 奇怪的灵气
正从那个入口传来。
如果你现在进去，会有大麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
You should definitely prepare
hunting stick if you want to
punish the Octopus.
Or I will not let you in! Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
如果你想惩罚小章鱼，
最好准备好捕猎棒。
不然我可不会让你进去哦！嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Yes Yes, you better quit.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
是是是，你最好赶紧离开。

scripts.text: Do you want to go out from the octopus dungeon?
scripts.translation: 你想离开小章鱼迷宫吗？

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！
